method: Row-by-row comparison of two independently extracted reads of two consecutive official PDFs, keyed on (matchup, team, player). Status changes are reported only where both editions carry the same key; rows present in one edition only are listed separately. Nothing is inferred.
caveats: Both editions were extracted twice - once per clipped-rectangle cell by scripts/verify_injury_edition_07920bdc.py and once by engine/injury_diff.py - and cross-checked before this diff was computed.
engine/injury_diff.py dropped 7 player rows present in the newer PDF (flag F-X01), so a diff computed from its output alone would have under-reported both editions. This diff uses the verified rows.
A row present in one edition only usually reflects a team filing or withdrawing a block, or a slate change, not a player status change.
